Guide and protect Jedur to find his father's inheritance.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}
* [[Mutu, the Oldest Child]] quest not active
* [[Misela, the Middle Child]] quest not active

===Objectives===
* Search the ruins of Fahranur to find where Nehbawa Wahmeh has hidden the family inheritance.
* Jedur Wahmeh must survive to recover his inheritance.
* See Healer Zenwa for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
After accepting the quest, accept Zenwa's offer to transport you to the ruins of Fahranur. Once you are there, fight your way through the undead hordes to Nehbawa Wahmeh's inheritance, which is marked by the compass point.

* Be careful walking around corners. Giant bells drop from above to crush the unwary.
* If using a [[survivor]] character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before [[Protection Prayers|protection]] on an AL 40 target.
* Once you make it to the inheritance, Jedur will retrieve it, and you will be transported back to Issnur Isles.
* If you are finding this quest difficult, start in [[Kodlonu Hamlet]], which allows up to 8 party members and provides access to level 15 henchmen.

==Dialogue==

;Healer Zenwa
:''"[Difficulty: Master] Your decision to give '''Jedur Wahmeh''' the '''inheritance''' of the Wahmeh family will be final and binding. Are you sure you wish to do this?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am certain. Jedur deserves the inheritance.
| decline = I'm not entirely sure. Give me a moment to think about it.
}}
:''"Nehbawa Wahmeh has hidden his inheritance deep within the ancient ruins of Fahranur. This was to be his final test, to prove his child's worth. Your entire party will leave Issnur Isles and join the heir you have chosen, assisting in the search for the inheritance. Are you ready?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Yes, let the search begin. I am confident I have chosen well!
| decline = No I'm not quite ready yet. Give me some more time to think on this matter.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Jedur Wahmeh:''' ''"When we find my father's treasure, I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Let's get going. The faster we find it, the faster i can spend it!"''
:'''Jedur Wahmeh:''' ''"Ha ha ha! The treasure, we found it! I'm rich! I'll be famous. I'll be powerful. I'll be everything I always wanted to be! Oh yes, and I'll make sure to reward you for helping me… someday."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Healer Zenwa
:''"Ahai! I am… glad to see you have returned… though your choice of Jedur disturbs me. I don't trust that young man in the least. I hope you saw something in him that I could not. Your services are no longer needed Sunspear, thank you for your… er… wisdom?"''
